capabilities: Play 12 classic mini-games such as Snake, Tetris, 2048, Minesweeper, Sudoku and Simon
Open games in a popup window, a separate tab, or a games hub
Choose Easy, Normal or Hard difficulty per game
Track session statistics and unlock 67 achievements
Switch the interface between English and Russian
extras: Not in the official Community plugins list; installed manually by copying the good-old-games folder into .obsidian/plugins. Requires Obsidian 1.0.0 or later. Saves from the old Mini Games (mini-games) and Mini Old Games 1.0.3 (mini-old-games) plugin ids are not picked up automatically.
motivation: The author wanted a two-minute break from note-taking or studying without leaving Obsidian, plus nostalgia for old phone and arcade games.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to take a short play break, so users must leave the vault to play casual games.

relations.evidence: If you previously used Mini Games (mini-games) or Mini Old Games 1.0.3 (mini-old-games)

summary: Bundle of 12 classic mini-games (Snake, Tetris, 2048, Sudoku, Simon) playable in a popup, tab, or hub, with difficulty levels, stats, and 67 achievements.
